refnamediv.refpurpose: Decodes session data from a session encoded string

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
boolsession_decode stringdata
session_decode decodes the serialized session data provided in data, and populates the $_SESSION superglobal with the result.
By default, the unserialization method used is internal to PHP, and is not the same as unserialize. The serialization method can be set using session.serialize_handler.
A session must be active, see session_start. With the php and php_binary handlers, the decoded variables are merged into the existing $_SESSION: variables with the same name are overwritten, the others are kept. With the php_serialize handler, the decoded value replaces $_SESSION as a whole.
